summary: Add retry with exponential backoff to the outbound webhook dispatcher
description: Webhook deliveries fail permanently on transient 5xx responses from subscribers. Add a bounded retry with exponential backoff and jitter to the dispatcher service, a config knob for max attempts, and tests covering the give-up path. Touches the dispatcher service, its config schema, and two test files.
rationale: Multiple files across directories and new test additions, but the strategic direction is obvious (well-understood retry pattern) — Medium per the rubric, no first-principles analysis needed.

summary: Intermittent duplicate message delivery after client reconnect
description: After a network blip, reconnecting streaming clients occasionally receive the same message twice. Reproduction is timing-dependent and unreliable. Root cause could be in the ack window, the resume-token handling, or the broker library upgraded last month (dependency manifest changed). Two plausible fix strategies with different trade-offs: idempotency keys at the consumer vs. tightening the ack protocol.
rationale: Unclear root cause, timing-dependent behavior, and multiple fix strategies with trade-offs — three independent Complex triggers per the rubric.

summary: Surface validation errors inline on the notification settings form
description: Server-side validation failures on the settings form currently render a generic banner. Surface per-field errors inline instead. Requires mapping the error payload in the form controller, extending the field component to render an error slot, and updating the form's integration test.
rationale: Controller + component + test across multiple directories following a well-understood pattern — Medium; too many moving pieces for Simple, no architectural questions for Complex.

summary: NullPointerException when exporting a report with no rows
description: Exporting an empty report throws an NPE. Stack trace points directly at ReportExporter.buildRows iterating a null result list. Fix is a guard returning an empty export. Existing export tests cover the non-empty paths and can validate the fix.
rationale: Single file, clear stack trace to root cause, obvious null-check fix pattern, existing coverage — all Simple criteria met.

summary: Wrong default for the batch-size flag causes single-item batches
description: The batch processor's --batch-size flag defaults to 1 instead of the documented 50, so nightly runs process one item at a time. One-line default correction in the flag definition; the existing config test asserts documented defaults and will catch regressions.
rationale: Single file, root cause self-evident from the flag definition, trivial fix pattern (wrong default), existing test to validate — Simple.

summary: Last page of paginated results is dropped when total is an exact multiple of page size
description: With 200 items and page size 50, only 3 pages render. Off-by-one in the page-count ceiling division in the paginator helper; error is visible in the failing boundary case. Fix the computation and add the missing boundary assertion to the paginator's existing test file.
rationale: Two closely related files (helper + its test), classic off-by-one with an obvious fix, existing test file to extend — Simple despite touching two files.

summary: Guard the new CSV export path behind a config toggle
description: The recently added CSV export needs to ship dark: add a config toggle, branch the export entry point on it, and keep the legacy XLSX path as the default. No toggle plumbing exists in the export module yet, so a new config accessor and a new test file for the toggle behavior are required alongside changes to the export entry point.
rationale: Boundary case: the fix direction is clear (Simple-ish), but it requires a new test file and touches three files across config and export modules — 'requires new test files' tips it to Medium.

summary: Crash on startup when the cache directory is missing
description: Fresh installs crash on first launch: stack trace points at CacheWarmer.open failing on a nonexistent directory. Fix is a mkdir-if-missing before open. The warmer, its config reader, and its test sit in the same package and all reference the path constant; existing startup tests cover the happy path and will validate the fix.
rationale: Boundary case: three files but all closely related in one package, clear stack trace, obvious fix pattern, existing coverage — the 'closely related files' clause keeps this Simple despite the file count.

summary: Add a read-only endpoint listing a workspace's pending invitations
description: Expose GET /workspaces/:id/invitations returning pending invites. Follows the existing controller + service + serializer + route + test pattern used by the members endpoint; no new auth rules (reuses workspace-viewer permission).
rationale: Five files across multiple directories following a well-understood pattern — squarely Medium: needs a plan for sequencing but zero strategic ambiguity.

summary: Consolidate duplicated config parsing into the shared settings helper
description: Three modules each hand-parse the same settings file section with subtle differences. Consolidate onto the existing shared settings helper, delete the local parsers, and extend the helper's test matrix with the two edge cases only the local parsers handled. Direction is settled — the shared helper is already the blessed pattern; the work is mechanical migration across five files plus tests.
rationale: Boundary case leaning Complex on file spread, but the strategic direction is obvious (blessed pattern already exists) and no system interactions change — 'needs a plan but the direction is obvious' keeps it Medium.

summary: Session tokens still accepted after password reset (second attempt)
description: Tokens minted before a password reset remain valid. A previous fix (linked ticket PROJ-1042, since reverted) invalidated tokens by bumping a per-user epoch but broke long-poll connections and was rolled back. Only the token validator and the reset handler are involved, but the retried-and-reverted history means the naive approach is known-insufficient.
rationale: Boundary case: small file count reads Simple/Medium, but a previous fix attempt failed and was reverted — an explicit Complex trigger that demands first-principles analysis before another attempt.

summary: Stale reads after write under concurrent cache invalidation across services
description: When the catalog service writes while the pricing service invalidates the shared cache entry, readers intermittently see the old value for several minutes. Suspected race between write-through and invalidation ordering; reproduction requires concurrent load. Any fix changes how the two services coordinate around the cache (versioned keys, invalidation bus ordering, or read-repair), each with different consistency and latency trade-offs.
rationale: Race condition, cross-service boundary, and multiple fix strategies with architectural implications — maximal Complex per the rubric.
